inv.desc_en:
Commercial Space for Rent with Profitability | 153 m² | Existing Contract +8 Years | +4.5% Profitability | €550,000

Ideal asset for investors seeking long-term stability and profitability.

Commercial space of 153 m² for sale, with an active tenant and an existing lease agreement with a duration of more than 8 years, generating a profitability of more than 4.5% per year.

Located in an area with excellent visibility and traffic, this space offers a solid and uncomplicated investment from day one.

Key Features:

Area: 153 m²

Contract: existing with a duration of more than 8 years

Net profitability: +4.5% per year

Solvent tenant with consolidated activity

Sale price: €550,000

Important:

To access detailed information and arrange a visit, it will be necessary to sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) beforehand.

Contact us for more information.
Stable contract. Solid profitability. Risk-free investment.
